title: Kill Anoriath
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract given by Nazir to assassinate Anoriath, a Bosmer hunter who works at his food stall in Whiterun's market by day and sleeps at The Drunken Huntsman by night.

base_facts: I am the Dark Brotherhood's quest handler and assign side contracts from the Sanctuary.
I reward completed contracts with leveled gold.

CONTRACT_GIVEN: I have assigned the contract to kill Anoriath, a hunter in Whiterun.
REWARD_COLLECTED: I have paid the leveled gold for Anoriath's death: 250 at early skill, up to 750 for a seasoned killer.
I remarked that the hunter came to know the fear of the hunted upon confirming the kill.
The Anoriath contract is closed; I may offer another side contract from the Sanctuary.
Killing Anoriath directly lowered his brother Elrindir's disposition, regardless of whether the deed was witnessed.

base_facts: I am a Bosmer hunter who runs a food stall in Whiterun's market during the day.
I sleep at The Drunken Huntsman at night, which is run by my brother Elrindir.
I never actually leave the city to hunt on the plains despite what some may say.

beats.comment: Player receives the contract from Nazir to kill Anoriath in Whiterun.
Anoriath has been killed; the objective to report back to Nazir is now active.
Player reports back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collects the leveled gold reward. Quest is complete.
